why: The default IS the boundary. `across` is absent from this call, so the same query that reaches six nodes with it must reach four without it, and no result may carry an `origin`. A server that spans by default has not made a foreign node visible — it has made every existing caller's answers change meaning without their asking, under class names that are this repository's. `scope` reads `local`, which is the field a caller checks to learn what actually happened.
